items.text: I don't react. I just ignore the person.

I moved out just before I turned 19 even though I had planned to be with my parents longer. I was going to college full time and working full time. Things had been really tense between my step mom and because she thought I wasn't spending enough time home. She just wanted me to raise my brothers so she didn't have to pay attention to them. My boyfriend (now fiance) and I  were going in a camping trip so I made sure that everything of mine around the house was picked up and my bathroom was clean, room clean, whatever. Morning of the camping trip 20 minutes before I'm set to leave she asks me to clean the bathroom again. I told her I had and she just rolled her eyes and stormed off. I finished loading up my camping gear and I went to let her know I was going, and she was in the bathroom scrubbing the already clean counters. Things got really heated between us and she started pushing me put of the house as we were both screaming. I finally just left and went to the store to get ice for the ice chest. Called my S/O and cried hysterically in a Fred Meyer parking lot. Then we went camping. I came back and packed my stuff, put it all in a storage locker, moved in with him.

I used to lay in bed thinking about everything I haven't done, but now i just run through a story sequence l. It's always the same story everytime and it plays like a movie in my head. This works out better than giving myself a panic attack about things I can't control.
